biggest_catch: Both $50 e-gift cards are only issued after the referred friend completes 60 days as an NRG customer — and Texas is served by sister company Reliant instead of NRG Home.
catches: The referred friend must remain an NRG customer for their first 60 days; the $50 e-gift cards are issued only after that period.
Texas customers are served by NRG sister company Reliant (separate program, covered by R0847), not the NRG Home referral program on picknrg.com.
E-gift cards, not bill credits; usable at retail merchants, not necessarily against the energy bill.
The page offers no further terms beyond the 60-day requirement and the no-limit statement.
Savings framing: the $50 e-gift card is a one-time reward tied to switching to an NRG energy plan; not cash income.

steps: As an NRG Home customer, refer a friend to NRG through the referral flow.
Your friend enrolls in an NRG electricity or natural gas plan (non-Texas markets).
Your friend remains an NRG customer for their first 60 days.
After the 60-day period, you and your friend each receive a $50 e-gift card.
Repeat with no limit on the number of referrals.
timing: $50 e-gift cards to both sides after the referred friend's first 60 days of being a customer.
